constraints.name: plan_allowances
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((name = 'FirstTouch'::text) AND (included_units = 4) AND (athletics_units = 0) AND (generation = ANY (ARRAY['legacy'::text, 'current'::text])) AND (billing_interval = 'month'::text)) OR ((name = 'GameChanger'::text) AND (included_units = 8) AND (athletics_units = 0) AND (generation = ANY (ARRAY['legacy'::text, 'current'::text])) AND (billing_interval = 'month'::text)) OR ((name = 'Pro-Player'::text) AND (athletics_units = 0) AND (((generation = 'legacy'::text) AND (included_units = 10)) OR ((generation = 'current'::text) AND (included_units = 12) AND (billing_interval = 'month'::text)))) OR ((name = 'NEXT LEVEL'::text) AND (generation = 'special'::text) AND (included_units = 12) AND (athletics_units = 4) AND (billing_interval = 'month'::text))))

storage_policies.name: report_object_read
storage_policies.using_expression:
((bucket_id = 'reports'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (report_files f
     JOIN report_snapshots s ON ((s.id = f.snapshot_id)))
  WHERE ((f.storage_path = objects.name) AND (is_admin() OR owns_player(s.player_id))))))
